verify_banner: Verify your email when you get a moment — check your inbox.
greeting:
Hi {{firstName}} — I'm your Research Copilot. I help you run interviews and surveys without the scheduling-and-analysis grind.

In about two minutes we'll have a real study ready to share — and I'll start learning what your research looks like so I can be more useful next time.

To start: what's the one thing you most need to learn about your users right now?
see_sample_link: Or see what a finished study looks like first →
input_placeholder: Tell the copilot what you want to learn…

study.hint: or keep chatting to refine it

website.default_prompt: Paste your company URL and I'll take a look.

done.sub: Pick what to do next — most teams test-drive their own interview first so they hear the AI in action.
done.memory_label: Here's what I'll remember about your research
done.memory_fallback: I'll learn more about your research as we work together.
done.plan_hint: Your trial includes everything in {{planName}} ({{monthly}}/mo). Stay on past Day 14 to keep going.

verify_modal.title: Want a recap of this conversation by email?
verify_modal.body: We'll also email you when your first response comes in — so you don't have to keep checking. Verify your email and you're set.

sample_modal.title: Here's what we'll build together
sample_modal.body: A finished study has a sharp objective, a recommended participant count for your team, and a lean interview guide. The Copilot drafts all of it from a 2-minute conversation. When you're ready, close this and tell me what you want to learn.

example.name: Why mid-market PMs choose Linear over Jira
example.objective: Understand the decision moment when product teams switch tools, so we can sharpen our positioning for the mid-market segment.
example.q1_question: Tell me about the last time your team chose a new tool — what was the spark?
example.q2_question: Walk me through how you evaluated the options. What mattered most?
example.q3_question: Looking back, what would have made the decision easier or faster?

chat_error: Sorry — I couldn't respond just now. Please try again.
